encoded: Set the background to #4e6963 and the link colour to rgb(101, 32, 119) before the warmup.
generator_cmd: printf %s 'Set the background to #4e6963 and the link colour to rgb(101, 32, 119) before the warmup.'  # a CSS-ish prose line (colour tokens embedded in English)
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | grep -qxE '([[:space:],;|]*(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|rgba?\([^)]*\)))+[[:space:],;|]*' || echo none  # GNU grep: the line is not made only of colour tokens
